info.title: Pennant
info.description: The presentation contract between the Pennant server and the Mac app (D-056). Generated by `npm run contract:build` from `server/contract/`; do not edit by hand.

tags.name: v2
tags.description: The Mac app's own API, under /api/v2.

tags.name: reused
tags.description: Routes the React app already serves, described for the Mac app.

bearer.description: The per-launch token the app hands the sidecar on stdin.

Counted.description: A whole number and a nullable one.

CountedRow.description: A generic is never exported; a concrete alias of it is, and becomes one named component.

Integer.description: A whole number: an id, a count, a season, a number of days. The spec says `type: integer`, so the Mac app reads an `Int`, not a `Double`. A true decimal (a rate, a slider, dollars) stays `number`. Named `Integer`, never `Int`, which the Swift generator would rename.

Mixed.description: A field that is a number or a string, with and without null.

SortKeys.description: A table row's sort keys, as `Row.sort` will carry them: a number, a string, or unknown (null).
